text: 32वें मिनट में Kingsmoor FC ने एक शानदार मौका बनाया! Felix Duarte की कम दूरी की पास के बाद Viktor Quinlan ने करीब 7.7 मीटर से शॉट लगाया, जिसे ब्लॉक कर दिया गया। इस शॉट का xG 0.347 था, मतलब यह मौका लगभग 3 में 1 बार गोल बनने जैसा था। स्कोर अभी 2-2 बराबर था और Kingsmoor ने चौतरफा खेल दिखाते हुए अपने बनाए मौके से खेल में दबदबा बनाए रखा[#559][#560][#563][#565].

- Viktor Quinlan missed a big chance with a blocked shot from 7.7 meters, having an xG of 0.347 [#565].
- The shot came after a short assist from Felix Duarte, following a 4-pass build-up that started from a free kick [#560-563].
- At this point, the score was tied 2-2 between Kingsmoor FC and Westport Albion.
- Kingsmoor FC played in a 4-4-2 formation with a wide, crossing play style coached by Pablo Iriarte.
- In the last 10 minutes, Kingsmoor FC had 56.0% possession and 83.1% pass accuracy but only 1 shot and no big chances.

- Kingsmoor FC won the ball via a set piece, a free kick awarded after a foul on Westport Albion's Aiden Zielinski [#559]. This allowed them to initiate a controlled build-up from deep on their own half (starting x=70.0 on their own side).
- The build-up involved four passes over nearly 14 seconds, demonstrating patience and possession-based play fitting Kingsmoor's 4-4-2 formation and their style emphasizing wide, crossing play. The sequence included medium and long passes with involvement of wing players like Felix Duarte and Hamza Strand, exploiting width to progress forward [#560-563].
- The move culminated in a short, key pass from Duarte to striker Viktor Quinlan inside the box, creating an open-play chance approximately 7.7 meters from goal [#563], highlighting Kingsmoor's pattern of building wide attacks and delivering cutbacks or short passes into central forwards.
- The resulting shot from Quinlan, though blocked, represented a high-quality chance with an xG of 0.347, indicating effective exploitation of space created through their crossing and build-up style rather than a direct vertical approach seen in the opposing Westport Albion's game [#565].
- Westport Albion’s 4-4-2 with a direct, vertical passing style likely ceded possession and allowed Kingsmoor to construct this sustained build-up from a set piece, as reflected by the controlled, multi-pass sequence leading to the big chance.
